name: Polygonal Number P(s, n)
description: Gives the n-th s-gonal number: the number of dots in a regular s-sided pattern with n dots per side.
notes: s = 3 gives triangular numbers, 4 squares, 5 pentagonal numbers. The 10th heptagonal number is 235.

name: Polygonal Number Test
description: Returns 1 when x is an s-gonal number, by solving P(s, n) = x for n and checking that n is a whole number.

name: Heptagonal Number
description: Gives the n-th heptagonal (7-sided) number.

name: Octagonal Number
description: Gives the n-th octagonal (8-sided) number.

name: Nonagonal Number
description: Gives the n-th nonagonal (9-sided) number.

name: Decagonal Number
description: Gives the n-th decagonal (10-sided) number.

name: Centred Triangular Number
description: Gives the n-th centred triangular number: a dot surrounded by n triangular layers.
notes: The sequence (from n = 0) runs 1, 4, 10, 19, 31, …; n = 10 gives 166.

name: Centred Square Number
description: Gives the n-th centred square number, the sum of two consecutive squares.

name: Centred Pentagonal Number
description: Gives the n-th centred pentagonal number.

name: Centred Hexagonal (Hex) Number
description: Gives the n-th centred hexagonal number: the cells in a hexagon with n cells per side, as in a honeycomb or Chinese checkers board.
notes: The sequence runs 1, 7, 19, 37, 61, …; the 10th is 271. The sums of the first n hex numbers are the cubes n³.

name: Star Number
description: Gives the n-th star number: the dots in a six-pointed star (hexagram), as on a Chinese checkers board.

name: Pentatope Number
description: Gives the n-th pentatope number, the four-dimensional analogue of the tetrahedral numbers.

name: Octahedral Number
description: Gives the number of spheres in an octahedron with n spheres along each edge.

name: Dodecahedral Number
description: Gives the n-th dodecahedral number.

name: Icosahedral Number
description: Gives the n-th icosahedral number.

name: Stella Octangula Number
description: Gives the n-th stella octangula number (an octahedral number with a tetrahedron on each face).

name: Centred Cube Number
description: Gives the n-th centred cube number: a cube of n³ points with a cube of (n − 1)³ points nested inside.
notes: The sequence runs 1, 9, 35, 91, 189, …; the 10th is 1729, the taxicab number.

name: Rhombic Dodecahedral Number
description: Gives the n-th rhombic dodecahedral number.

name: Pentagonal Pyramidal Number
description: Gives the number of balls in a pyramid with a pentagonal base of side n.

name: Hexagonal Pyramidal Number
description: Gives the number of balls in a pyramid with a hexagonal base of side n.

name: Square Triangular Number
description: Gives the n-th number that is both a perfect square and a triangular number.
notes: They are 1, 36, 1225, 41,616, 1,413,721, …, found through Pell's equation x² − 2y² = 1.

name: Pronic (Oblong) Number Test
description: Returns 1 when n is a product of two consecutive integers k(k + 1).
notes: 132 = 11 × 12. Pronic numbers are twice the triangular numbers.

name: Sum of Consecutive Cubes Identity
expression: sum(k, 1, n, k^3) - sum(k, 1, n, k)^2
description: Checks Nicomachus's theorem that 1³ + 2³ + … + n³ equals (1 + 2 + … + n)²; the difference is always 0.
notes: A visual proof arranges the cubes into a square of side n(n + 1)/2.
